ImageDescription.value: Trollstigen, part of provincial road 63, Norway. A spectacular serpentine road with 11 hairpin bends and a gradient of up to 12 percent, which reaches a pass height of 700 meters with a difference in altitude of 410 meters. The road is only a few meters wide and almost one lane in places.
